verdict.rationale: smolagents is a code-first Python library, so its programmatic API is the primary interface. Running agents, stepping, replaying, reading memory, multi-agent setup and Hub push/pull are all documented as API calls, and the CLI utilities only spare users boilerplate rather than adding UI-only capabilities. missing for 10: no documented UI feature set to verify parity against, no network/REST API for the agent runtime, no independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: `smolagents` is a library that enables you to run powerful agents in a few lines of code.
result = agent.run("Calculate the sum of numbers from 1 to 10")
Comes with command-line utilities (smolagent, webagent) for quickly running agents without writing boilerplate code.
